name: GDELT Project
description: Machine-coded index of worldwide online news coverage, searchable by keyword, place, theme and tone.
terms: Free for any use incl. commercial; must cite GDELT + link.
reliability: Aggregated/automated (not verified reporting); English and Western-media heavy; titles normalized; updates every 15 min.

name: Wikipedia Portal: Current events
description: Daily volunteer-written summary of notable world events, each linked to cited news reports.
terms: CC BY-SA 4.0: attribution + licence notice; share-alike on adaptations.
reliability: Secondary (summarizes press); editorial selection bias toward English-language coverage; updated daily.

name: ReliefWeb
description: Humanitarian reports, maps and situation updates from UN agencies, NGOs and governments.
terms: Site content for personal, non-commercial use; link only.
reliability: Curated aggregator of primary humanitarian documents; strong on crises, thin on non-humanitarian news; updated continuously.

name: GDACS
description: Automated alerts and impact estimates for earthquakes, tsunamis, cyclones, floods and volcanoes.
terms: Own terms page 404; footer links European Commission legal notice (CC BY 4.0 for EU-owned content) - site-specific licence not confirmed.
reliability: Primary automated alert system (JRC/UN); early model estimates can be revised; near-real-time.

name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
description: Real-time global earthquake locations and magnitudes as GeoJSON/ATOM feeds.
terms: U.S. public domain; credit requested.
reliability: Primary authoritative source; automatic solutions revised after review; near-real-time feeds, cadence varies by feed.

name: WHO Disease Outbreak News
description: WHO's official notices on confirmed or potential acute public-health events.
terms: WHO publications CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO - link only, no commercial reuse of text.
reliability: Primary (member-state reported); published after verification so can lag events; irregular cadence.

name: ACLED
description: Coded dataset of political violence and protest events worldwide.
terms: Restrictive EULA: commercial entities need a corporate licence; no scraping; outputs must be transformative.
reliability: Primary coded dataset from media/local partners; reporting-density bias; weekly updates.

name: UCDP
description: Academic datasets on organized violence, battle deaths and conflict actors since 1946.
terms: CC BY 4.0 with citation of listed publications.
reliability: Primary academic coding with strict inclusion rules; annual releases plus monthly candidate events.

name: HDX
description: Open platform hosting humanitarian datasets (population, displacement, infrastructure) from many organizations.
terms: Licence set per dataset by contributor; users must follow it; no personal data allowed.
reliability: Aggregator of third-party datasets; quality and freshness vary by contributor.

name: International Crisis Group - CrisisWatch
description: Monthly conflict tracker rating deterioration/improvement in ~70 situations.
terms: Terms page could not be read when checked on September 27, 2026. Read the provider's terms before reusing its data.
reliability: Expert analytical NGO (secondary assessment, not raw data); monthly.

name: OFAC Sanctions List Service
description: U.S. Treasury's official sanctions lists in downloadable formats.
terms: Treasury-specific copyright statement not located; U.S. government work (17 U.S.C. §105) - inference.
reliability: Primary legal source; updated whenever designations change.

name: UN Security Council Consolidated List
description: All individuals and entities under UN Security Council sanctions measures.
terms: un.org terms: personal non-commercial; link only.
reliability: Primary legal source; updated on committee decisions.

name: EU Financial Sanctions consolidated list
description: The EU's consolidated list of persons and entities subject to financial sanctions.
terms: data.europa.eu editorial content CC BY 4.0; the dataset's own licence line was not captured.
reliability: Primary (DG FISMA); updated on new Council acts.

name: EU Sanctions Map
description: Interactive map of EU restrictive measures by country and regime with legal acts.
terms: Disclaimer/terms text not captured.
reliability: Official EU tool but not the legally binding text (Official Journal is).

name: UK Sanctions List
description: UK government's list of designated persons, entities and ships.
terms: GOV.UK content under Open Government Licence v3.0.
reliability: Primary legal source; updated on designation changes.

name: US Consolidated Screening List
description: Combined export-screening lists from Commerce, State and Treasury.
terms: Intended for public use and dissemination.
reliability: Aggregation of official lists; check source list for legal effect; updated daily per ITA (unverified).

name: OpenSanctions
description: Consolidated, deduplicated sanctions, PEP and watchlist data from many official sources.
terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 - commercial use needs a licence.
reliability: Aggregated from primary lists; entity matching may merge/split records; frequent updates.

name: World Bank - Debarred & ineligible firms
description: Firms and individuals barred from World Bank-financed contracts.
terms: World Bank site: informational, non-commercial unless stated.
reliability: Primary institutional list; covers WB sanctions (and cross-debarments) only.

name: SEC EDGAR
description: U.S. public-company filings (10-K, 8-K, ownership, etc.) with full-text search.
terms: Public information; may be copied/distributed; cite SEC.
reliability: Primary filings (company-submitted, not audited by SEC); real-time.

name: OpenCorporates
description: Largest open database of companies aggregated from official registers worldwide.
terms: ODbL: attribution 'from OpenCorporates' hyperlink; share-alike if combined.
reliability: Aggregator of registries; freshness depends on each registry; contains officer names.

name: UK Companies House
description: Official register of UK companies, officers, filings and persons with significant control.
terms: Public data free of charge; officer personal data - handle responsibly.
reliability: Primary register; filings are self-reported and largely unverified; daily updates.

name: GLEIF - Global LEI Index
description: Legal Entity Identifiers with reference and parent-ownership data.
terms: CC0.
reliability: Primary (issuer-validated); only entities that obtained an LEI; daily.

name: Data.gov (US)
description: Catalog of U.S. federal (and some state/local) open datasets.
terms: Federal data generally free/unrestricted; non-federal datasets vary.
reliability: Catalog/aggregator; quality varies by agency; links may rot.

name: data.europa.eu
description: EU institutions' and member states' open datasets in one catalog.
terms: Editorial content CC BY 4.0 (Decision 2011/833/EU); dataset licences vary.
reliability: Catalog/aggregator; metadata quality varies.

name: data.gov.uk
description: UK government's catalog of published datasets.
terms: OGL v3.0 except where stated.
reliability: Catalog; some entries link to stale or moved data.

name: World Bank Open Data
description: Development indicators (economy, health, population) for all countries.
terms: CC BY 4.0 unless labelled; mandatory attribution format.
reliability: Compiled from national statistics; lags of 1-2 years common.

name: Global Fishing Watch
description: Map and datasets of apparent fishing and vessel activity from AIS and satellite data.
terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial only.
reliability: Model-derived activity (AIS gaps, dark vessels); near-real-time with delays.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
description: Access to Sentinel satellite imagery and browser-based viewing.
terms: Sentinel data free, full and open under the Sentinel legal notice; other portal content non-commercial.
reliability: Primary satellite data; resolution 10 m+; revisit several days; clouds.

name: NASA FIRMS
description: Near-real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections from MODIS/VIIRS.
terms: NASA Earthdata: CC0 unless marked; no endorsement.
reliability: Primary satellite detections; false positives (industrial heat); ~3 h latency.

name: NASA Worldview
description: Browser for daily global satellite imagery layers.
terms: Same Earthdata policy (CC0 unless marked; no endorsement).
reliability: Primary imagery; coarse resolution for most layers; daily.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
description: Search and download Landsat and other USGS earth-observation archives.
terms: USGS public domain; credit requested.
reliability: Primary archive; Landsat 30 m, 16-day revisit.

name: ICANN Lookup
description: Registration data lookup for domain names via RDAP.
terms: Lookup-specific terms not captured; ICANN ToS grants no IP licence. Many registrant fields redacted.
reliability: Primary registry/registrar data; privacy redactions limit registrant info.

name: crt.sh
description: Searches public Certificate Transparency logs for TLS certificates issued to domains.
terms: No terms page found - only copyright notice.
reliability: Primary CT log data; occasional downtime/timeouts.

name: RIPEstat
description: Routing, prefix, ASN and registration statistics from the RIPE NCC.
terms: Network analysis/research; no commercial repackaging without written permission.
reliability: Primary RIR + RIS routing data; near-real-time.

name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
description: Looks up ASNs, prefixes, peers and routing relationships.
terms: No terms page found.
reliability: Vantage point of one network; updated continually.

name: PeeringDB
description: Interconnection database of networks, exchanges and facilities.
terms: Operational/research use only; no reproduction or commercial application.
reliability: Self-reported by networks; accuracy varies.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
description: Historical snapshots of web pages; also 'Save Page Now'.
terms: Primary ToS page JS-only (not read); access policy page quoted.
reliability: Primary archive; gaps for robots-excluded or removed sites.

name: IFCN Code of Principles signatories
description: Directory of fact-checking organizations vetted against the IFCN code.
terms: Directory; no reuse licence captured.
reliability: Vetted directory; renewal status changes over time.

name: InVID-WeVerify verification plugin
description: Browser extension for video/image verification (keyframes, reverse search, metadata).
terms: Free tool; licence terms not captured.
reliability: Tool, not a source; results need human judgment.

name: Google Fact Check Explorer
description: Searches ClaimReview-tagged fact-checks from publishers worldwide.
terms: Google Terms of Service apply.
reliability: Aggregator of publisher fact-checks; only ClaimReview-tagged items.

name: EUvsDisinfo
description: EU database and analysis of pro-Kremlin disinformation cases.
terms: Reuse licence not found; disclaimer says not an official EU position.
reliability: Government-run (EU) project with narrow focus; state source - note perspective.

name: Duke Reporters' Lab fact-checking database
description: Global map/database of active fact-checking projects.
terms: No reuse licence captured.
reliability: Academic census of fact-checkers; update cadence not verified.

name: EDMO
description: EU hub linking fact-checkers and researchers on disinformation.
terms: Terms page could not be read when checked on September 27, 2026. Read the provider's terms before reusing its data.
reliability: EU-funded network; European focus.

name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
description: U.S. government list of vulnerabilities confirmed exploited in the wild.
terms: CC0.
reliability: Primary; only CVEs with evidence of exploitation; updated as entries are added.

name: NIST National Vulnerability Database
description: Enriched CVE records with CVSS scores and CPE data.
terms: Public information; API users must show non-endorsement notice.
reliability: Primary enriched source. Enrichment may lag CVE publication.

name: CVE Program
description: Authoritative catalog of CVE identifiers and descriptions.
terms: Perpetual royalty-free licence; reproduce MITRE copyright and licence.
reliability: Primary identifiers; descriptions vary in depth.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques.
terms: Royalty-free licence incl. commercial; reproduce copyright + licence.
reliability: Curated framework (not a live feed); versioned releases.

name: FIRST EPSS
description: Daily probability scores that a CVE will be exploited.
terms: Free; attribution requested.
reliability: Model-based estimate (not ground truth); daily.

name: Bellingcat Online Investigations Toolkit
description: Categorized, annotated directory of open-source investigation tools.
terms: Inclusion is not endorsement.
reliability: Curated secondary directory; tool status changes.

name: GIJN Resource Center
description: Guides and tipsheets for investigative journalists.
terms: CC BY-NC 4.0 - link, don't republish commercially.
reliability: Practitioner guidance; updated regularly.

name: Verification Handbook
description: Practitioner handbook on verifying digital content and disinformation.
terms: Licence not captured.
reliability: Edited handbook (2020); some tool references dated.

name: Berkeley Protocol on Digital Open Source Investigations
description: UN/Berkeley standards for legally sound online open-source investigation.
terms: Reuse terms not captured (UN publication).
reliability: Methodology standard; static publication.

name: Amnesty Citizen Evidence Lab
description: Amnesty's methods and case studies for digital human-rights investigations.
terms: Reuse terms not captured.
reliability: NGO methods resource; advocacy organization (note perspective).
